latest_release.name: v6.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

![Application packet with approved resume and letter versions, answers and manual downloads](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/9390156a0a4b2d41f43452ea1ab5054a764bf254/docs/images/guides/career/employer-form-packet-v2.png)

- **Apply with everything in one place.** Saved jobs now open on **Apply**, which walks you through the posting, a tailored resume, an optional letter and form answers. Keep contact details, work authorization, salary expectations and references in a private **Profile**, save reviewed answers to reuse in later applications, and review the complete application packet before you send it. On desktop Chrome and Edge, the browser helper fills supported employer form fields after you approve them; on phones, copy your answers and download the approved PDFs. [99653bb50](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/99653bb50), [a8b6f042a](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/a8b6f042a), [74b49c0ec](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/74b49c0ec), [440688dec](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/440688dec), [bd2ebbbed](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/bd2ebbbed)
- **Save jobs straight from the posting.** Capture a posting with the desktop browser helper or your phone's share sheet, correct the details, then save it as a new job or update the one you already track. Postings the assistant reads can also be saved as a job and linked to your resume in one step. [39aa6c15c](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/39aa6c15c), [2c39d1d4e](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/2c39d1d4e)
- **Get feedback from a coach or friend.** Make a private feedback link for each reviewer from **Share**. It shows your resume as it was when you made the link, can collect comments and show progress on up to 20 applications you choose, and expires when you decide. Reviewers don't need an account. [f547e182a](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/f547e182a)

![Translate into dialog creating a separate language copy of a resume](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/9390156a0a4b2d41f43452ea1ab5054a764bf254/docs/images/guides/career/language-copy.png)

- **Make a copy of your resume in another language.** Choose **Translate into…** to create a separate copy in another language. The assistant translates the copy for your review, and your original stays unchanged. [f5c7058b7](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/f5c7058b7)
- **Work faster with the keyboard.** Press **?** to see the shortcuts for the current screen. In the Applications list, use **j** and **k** to move between jobs, **1**–**5** to change stage, **x** to select and **f** to log a follow-up; **/** focuses search. Ctrl or Cmd with the mouse wheel zooms the resume page. Single-key shortcuts can be turned off in Preferences. [58e285421](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/58e285421), [40939feb4](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/40939feb4), [0a9f421ba](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/0a9f421ba), [c4731eea8](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/c4731eea8)
- **Deleted applications go to Trash.** Deleting an application now moves it to Trash with its timeline, contacts and documents, so you can restore it. Trash also gained bulk Restore, Delete permanently and Empty Trash for documents. [b2fa683bc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/b2fa683bc), [ddedd46dc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/ddedd46dc)

## Applications & Job Search

- Added **Needs you**, a filter for applications waiting on you, and a **Followed up** action that records contact without changing the stage. **Copy and log as replied** records a recruiter reply when you copy your drafted response. [b79c4417e](https://github.com/reactive
